description.text:
锡亚丹伦的女族长们从来都不喜欢他们帝国的北部地区，那些在石之树的阴影下或到达乔尔芙之外的地方。然而，贾赫和他的凤凰军团的到来打破了女族长国，使锡亚丹的女族长太过虚弱，多年来都无法重申他们对北方鹰身女妖部族的控制。

自从锡亚丹伦的分裂以来，北方的部族一直保持冷漠，拒绝与南方的姐妹们重新融合。相反，他们在很大程度上是根据女先知、传奇人物锡亚杜娜·焰爪的孙女穆拉·迅雀的教导来管理自己。穆拉的教导注重合作、说服和外交，长期以来被嘲笑为不切实际的梦想家的软弱哲学，但遥远的穆伦的天空女王不这么看。穆伦的哲学倾向以公平但激烈的谈判者而闻名，尽管权力下放，但却使他们的女王国惊人地团结起来，他们擅长讨价还价和谈判，在贸易和战争事务中都运用了这一点。
description.text_en:
The Matriarchs of Siadanlén never favored the northern reaches of their empire: those that sat in the shadow of the Tree of Stone or reached to the sands beyond Çhórfo. The coming of Jaher and his Phoenix legions broke the Matriarchy, however, and left the Matriarchs of Siádan too weak to reassert their control over the northern flocks for many years.

Since the Sundering of Siadanlén, the northern clans have remained aloof and resistant to reintegration with their sisters to the south. Instead, they largely govern themselves according to the teachings of Múla Swift-Sparrow, prophetess and granddaughter of the legendary Siadúna Flaming-Talon. Múla's teachings, which focused on cooperation, persuasion, and diplomacy were long derided as a weak philosophy of an impractical dreamer, but the sky matriarchs of distant Mulén do not see it this way. Carrying a reputation as fair but fierce negotiators, the Muléni philosophical leanings have made their matriarchy surprisingly cohesive despite its decentralization, and well skilled at haggling and negotiation, which they put to use in matters of trade as well as war.

description.text:
很少有人胆敢冒险穿越乔尔芙，这是一条蜿蜒的东部通道，分隔了禁忌平原和布勒瓦尔，因为隘口两边都对入侵者充满敌意——锡亚杜娜鹰身女妖在南边突袭配偶和宝藏，而北方的半人马部落屠杀那些不幸遇到他们的人。这两个群体很少互相争斗，但当这种冲突发生时，是穆伦的鹰身女妖与平原居民开战，并把他们赶回隘口。

她们几个世纪以来一直与半人马作战，半人马是一种敏捷而强大的战士，可以一击致命，这使得穆兰的战士喜欢躲避和防御技术。穆兰的战斗风格注重保护战士的生命和谨慎的行为，这使她们的战术有别于大多数其他鹰身女妖，但在与身体比她们强壮得多的敌人战斗时，她们表现得很好。
description.text_en:
There are few who are foolhardy enough to attempt to travel through Çhórfo, the winding eastern passage that separates the Forbidden Plains from Bulwar, for both sides of the pass are hostile to trespassers - Siadúnan Harpies to the south raid for mates and treasure, while the centaur tribes of the north slaughter those who are unfortunate enough to cross their paths. These two groups rarely fight with each other, but when such conflicts do occur it is the harpies of Mulén who war with the plains-dwellers and drive them back across the pass.

Their centuries of fighting against centaurs, swift and powerful warriors who could kill with one firm blow, have led to the warriors of Mulén favoring evasive and defensive techniques. Practicing a fighting style that focuses on the preservation of its warriors' lives and cautious behavior sets the tactics of Muléni flocks apart from most other harpies, but has served them well when fighting foes physically much stronger than they.

name.text: 对抗北方掠夺者的坚盾

description.text: 东蛇脊山脉的山峰上有广阔的冰川、松林和野性之美。在空气变得稀薄和寒冷的地方，穆兰的萨满们聚集在一起，歌颂自由的天空，并重复着自菲兰雅时代以来流传下来的许多传说。它们轻快的颤音在这里的山峰上回响，带着大多数鹰身女妖歌曲中常见的刺耳尖叫的痕迹。穆兰崎岖的土地经常被这奇怪而缥缈的歌声所穿透，这种声音似乎带着多重音符在每一次呼吸中回响。这种技巧与萨满们所唱的许多故事和祈祷一起代代相传，而穆兰的每一个女儿都将这些故事铭记在心。
description.text_en: The high peaks of the Eastern Serpentspine are a place of vast glaciers, pine forests, and wild beauty. Where the air grows thin and chill, the shamans of Mulén gather to sing praise of the free sky and repeat the many legends that have been passed down since the days of Firanya. Their lilting trills echo from the peaks here, nary a trace of the harsh shrieking common in most harpy songs to be heard. The rugged lands of Mulén are often pierced through by this strange and ethereal song, a sound that seems to carry multiple notes reverberating with each breath. This singing technique is passed down to each new generation alongside the many stories and prayers that the shamans sing, and each daughter of Mulén carries these tales in her heart and mind.

description.text:
虽然我们在锡亚丹的姐妹只知道残忍，除了力量什么都不关心，但我们还不至于堕落到无法从萨拉哈德的其他民族学到任何东西的地步。在穆兰，我们人民的生活是艰苦的，但我们是通过合作而不是野蛮才能生存下来的——难道其他民族就不能这样吗？矮人知道手艺，犍计阗的畜牧技术，而马什恩希赫人知道严酷沙漠的秘密。即使是把古老的锡亚丹伦打败的沙漠精灵，也值得学习，因为他们信奉宽容和共存的理念，这一点与穆拉·迅雀如出一辙。

虽然我们的祖先为我们建立的声誉可能不值得信任，但这些教训的诱惑是巨大的。当我们突袭黄金大道上的商队时，商人们认为我们是入侵者，但如果我们想在与世隔绝的情况下成长为一个民族，我们就必须不仅仅是强盗。相反，如果我们想要超越现在，我们必须了解这些民族所知道的——是什么让他们制造，而不仅仅是索取。
description.text_en:
While our sisters in Siádan know only cruelty and care for nothing other than strength, we are not so far descended into monstrousness that we can learn nothing from the other peoples of the Salahad. The lives of our people are harsh in Mulén, but it is through cooperation, not savagery, that we survive - could it not be so with other peoples? The dwarves know of craftsmanship, the Ghankedhen techniques of husbandry, the Mašnsih the secrets of the harsh desert. Even the desert elves, who laid ancient Siadanlén low, have lessons to teach, for they espouse a message of tolerance and coexistence not unlike that of Múla Swift-Sparrow.

Though we may not be trusted for the reputation our foremothers have built for us, the lure of these lessons is great. When we descend upon the caravans of the Golden Highway, the traders expect us to come as raiders, but we must be more than bandits if we are to grow as a people despite our isolation. Instead, we must learn what these peoples know - what it is that lets them make, not just take - if we are ever to be more than what we are now.

description.text: 正如南域联盟的矮人可以证明的那样，蛇脊中部的山脉拥有巨大的财富，但在历史上，鹰身女妖群并没有有效地利用她们爪子下的巨大财富。在中蛇脊和石之树的关键处，可以发现各种各样的和有价值的金属和矿物，虽然许多对鹰身女妖没有用处，但它们对那些在黄金大道上来来往往的商人来说价值不菲。虽然一开始的贸易是试探性的，信任的到来是缓慢的，但穆兰的鹰身女妖们将被证明是自愿的贸易商和熟练的商人，他们接近商队不是恶兆，而是好运和好消息，用原始宝石交换工作材料和在鹰身女妖无法飞行的狭小的空间里开采宝石的奴隶。这种状况越来越多，17世纪早期，看到残忍贪婪的天空展翅于萨拉哈德是好运的象征，而不是厄运，尽管许多人仍然不信任她们，有翼的交易员的出现是有据可查的现象，很少被忽略。
description.text_en: As the dwarves of the Segbandal would attest, the mountains of the middle Serpentspine hold great riches, but the harpy flocks have not historically been effective at utilizing the vast riches resting beneath their talons. At the crux of the Middle Serpentspine and the Tree of Stone, a varied and valuable collection of metals and minerals can be found, and while many were not useful for harpies, they could be worth a great deal to those merchants passing up and down the Golden Highway. Though trade would at first be tentative and trust slow to come, the harpies of Mulén would prove to be willing traders and adept merchants, their descent upon merchant caravans not a sign of ill omen but instead good fortune and glad tidings, exchanging raw gems for worked materials and supplies for their miners, who could dig in cramped spaces that the harpies could not navigate. More and more, by the early 17th century AA, the sight of harpies winging their way across the skies of the Far Salahad was a sign of good fortune instead of ill, and though many still distrusted them, the appearance of the winged traders was a well documented phenomenon that few ignored.

description.text: 历史上，鹰身女妖在社会中的地位由许多因素决定：战斗的威力，伴侣的数量，身体的美丽，但很少是通过他们的黄金财富或外国关系的数量评判。然而，随着穆兰商人变得越来越成功，并在巴加纳什附近建立了永久的据点，一小群突袭首领开始通过与来往罗祆的商队进行贸易而变得非常富有。这些所谓的「商人女族长」采用了他们经常与之交谈的罗祆和布勒瓦尔商人的技巧，以便将自己的财富转化为政治权力，并开始成为穆兰族群内部政治的主要力量。
description.text_en: Historically, the status of a harpy in her society was determined by many things; prowess in battle, number of mates, physical beauty, but rarely if ever by their wealth in gold or number of foreign connections. As the Muléni traders became more successful and established permanent roosts near Baganaš, however, a small group of raid leaders began to grow very wealthy from trading with caravans passing to and from Rahen. These so called 'merchant-matriarchs' adopted techniques from the Raheni and Bulwari traders they so regularly conversed with in order to leverage their wealth into political power, and began to become a major force in the internal politics of Muléni flocks.

description.text: 17世纪晚期，大量的财富流入了穆兰鹰身女妖们的爪下，这些资金主要被用于扩建她们的栖巢，开启了一个将穆兰鹰身女妖的高山定居点转变为建筑和工程奇迹的过程。远高于伊安维蕾莉，梅尔弥甘和塔尔努腾的平原，坐落在山脉的肩膀和巨大的悬崖峭壁下，穆兰鹰身女妖的栖巢将从小型的巢穴和泥屋变成真正的城市。这些由砖和石头雕刻而成的城市是为鹰身女妖旅行而设计的，其独特的建筑风格允许人们步行，也可以通过飞行方便地到达和离开，城市的规划也考虑到了三维运动。不仅仅是惊人的美景，还有让人眩晕的下降，包含浴场，花园，图书馆和大市场的悬挂城市，许多商人长途跋涉到这些遥远孤立的城镇，被其大量财富所诱惑并有机会见证奇迹的锡亚杜娜天空之城。
description.text_en: The great wealth that flowed into the talons of the Muléni matrons in the late 1600s AA was channeled largely into the aggrandizement of their roosts, beginning a process of transforming the high mountain settlements of the Mulén harpies into marvels of architecture and engineering. Far above the plains of Ianviréri, Mermigán, and Tarnúthen, nestled on shoulders of mountains and undersides of vast cliff outcroppings, the roosts of the Muléni harpies would transform from small collections of nests and mud huts into true cities. Sculpted of brick and stone, the cities were oriented for harpy travel, and featured unique architecture that allowed walking as well as easy arrival and departure via flight, and the cities were planned with three-dimensional movement in mind. Beyond just the breathtaking vistas and vertigo-inducing drops, the hanging cities of Mulén featured baths, gardens, libraries, and great markets, and many a merchant made treks to these remote isolated towns, as much for the lure of the riches they contained as the experience of having witnessed the wonder of the Siadúnan Sky-Cities.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿承担强邻压力、长期建设门槛或派系协调的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先利用法师与军队打开商路，中期投资城市和贸易伙伴，后期立宪、升级巢穴并管理更广商业网络。
player_overview.overview: 穆兰从荒漠山地的母系部落出发，开局有强力附魔统治者，却仍要突破强邻与贫弱商路。你会恢复黄金大道、建起供有翼与无翼居民生活的悬吊城市，再协调商人孔雀派与传统麻雀派。贸易繁荣带来移民和城市，也带来需要用宪法约束的新权力。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢贸易种田、城市工程、法师开局和制度演变的玩家。
signature_features: 悬吊城市及浴场、花园、图书馆的长期建设。
孔雀与麻雀派系竞争，后期可立宪限制权力。
黄金大道、反奴隶贸易和跨地区商贸网络相连。
player_overview.tagline: 把鹰身女妖的山地部群变成拥有悬吊城市、黄金大道和一部宪法的商业国度。

reasons: 悬吊城市的建设形态鲜明
贸易繁荣直接改变内部政治
同Tag终局与跨地区商路提供长期目标
warnings: 开局强力法师不能消除地缘压力

positive_indicators: 拆除奴隶市场并发展非奴产业
保护剩余豺狼人免遭继续报复
接纳移民并用宪法限制派系权力
values.rationale: 任务明确拆除奴隶市场、接纳移民、修复经济、约束两派权力并保护解放后仍存的豺狼人；同时有统治文化更替导致荒废、解放后的驱逐与报复，以及征服地精后组织矿业等强制关系。评分计入具体手段与灾后保护，不因贸易、母系政体或扩张自动加分。
red_flags: 地方统治文化更替造成荒废
解放后出现针对豺狼人的驱逐与报复
以征服及强势控制组织部分矿工和部群
